module: "Delivery > Fluid Cargo" career debug tab. 'Fluid CargoDebug' ImGui window that shows, per delivery facility (all, the nearest or a chosen one), the material (fluid) storages: suppliers, rates and connections, relying on career_modules_delivery_* and career_modules_debug_parcelDebug.
notes: Development tool; the references to the delivery modules are taken in onCareerActivated, so it is unusable before career is activated.

debugOrder.desc: Sort order in the debug window (11).

onCareerActivated.desc: Career hook: stores the delivery modules (parcelManager, cargoScreen, general, generator, progress, vehicleOfferManager) and career_modules_debug_parcelDebug.

drawDebugFunctions.desc: Debug functions submenu; empty in this module.

drawDebugMenu.desc: Draws the 'Fluid CargoDebug' window: delivery time, facility choice (all, auto, or a facility with materialStorages) and a Fluid / Rate / Connections table per facility.
